review.imagery: 52 gallery entries include 9 dated site photographs. All 29 primary assets, the complete 66-page brochure index, eighteen native resources and nine September 2026 site photographs were visually reviewed. One lower-resolution aerial crop and three repeated brochure scenes were excluded. Fifteen brochure scenes add marina, garden, lobby, clubhouse and home interiors. Several project-published exterior views include both adjoining Cotier phases and retain combined-development context. Historical site photographs can include the neighbouring phase and surrounding works.
review.floorPlans: All thirteen whole physical pages 2–14 were visually reviewed on four contacts and carry the Cotier House 2 header. Ground/podium 1 retain paired 3 BR townhouse portions. Upper residential levels retain their paired duplex scope. No individual areas or extra roof drawing occur in this packet. The inspected Silver Oak project page exposes no open floor-plan section. No contractual area was inferred from a full-level drawing. Thirteen complete Cotier House 2 building drawings retain the townhouse, apartment and paired duplex portions. No individual saleable areas are printed. Separate portions are parts of multi-level homes. Confirm complete contractual home sheets, area tables and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original brochure maps 11 and 13 were rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. The six selected estimates follow map 11’s schedule. Map 13 distinguishes the adjoining Cotier House and Cotier House 2 plots. Its schematic supplies no latitude/longitude. The official named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinate pair.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and historical September 2026 construction pages retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original branded brochures and plan packets retain actual Mitchell’s, REMapp or Reelly host attribution. Whole sheets, notices and source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual home areas, complete standalone townhouse/duplex home drawings, an additional roof sheet, exact visitor entrance, final phase-specific outlook and specifications, and current certified site progress remain unavailable or unverified.
